title: Identity zones
slide_intent: Teach teams to match a communication task with the design judgment it requires. A reusable identifier and an emotive campaign make different demands on the people producing them.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can distribute routine work locally while directing more complex creative work to suitably skilled designers.
demonstration: Three columns describe Core identity, Operational and Agency. The icons change from a filled central dot to middle and outer rings. A bottom row specifies the level of expertise for each zone.
practical_value: Decide whether an item can use a template, needs in-house design skills or warrants a professional agency brief.

content_islands.name: Zone introduction
content_islands.spec: Place the premise and red exercise in the narrow left column.

content_islands.name: Zone comparison
content_islands.spec: Order three ruled columns from Core identity through Operational to Agency. Use a concentric target above each heading.

content_islands.name: Production guidance
content_islands.spec: Align the bold expertise statements across the bottom, separated from examples by fine red rules.
